source.label: theorem:2
source.quote: The pseudo-regret of Tsallis-INF with $\eta_t = \frac{4}{\sqrt{t}}$ and reduced variance loss estimators defined in equation \eqref{eq:rv}, in any adversarial bandit problem satisfies \Reg \leq 2\sqrt{(K-1)T}+\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{T}+14K\log(T) + \frac{3}{4}\sqrt{K} + 15.

results.notes: Learning rate schedule does not depend on T, so anytime.

extra_assumptions: Delta has a unique zero entry i*

source.label: theorem:2
source.quote: Furthermore, if there exists a vector $\Delta \in [0,1]^K$ with a unique zero entry $i^*$ ... and a constant $C\geq 0$, such that the pseudo-regret at time $T$ satisfies the $(\Delta, C, T)$ self-bounding constraint ..., then the pseudo-regret additionally satisfies: \overline{Reg}_T \leq \sum_{i\neq i*} \frac{1}{\Delta_i}((\log \frac{T(K-1)}{(\sum_{i\neq i^*} \frac{1}{\Delta_i})^2}) + 6) + 28K \log(T) + \frac{3}{2}\sqrt{K} + 30 + C.
